app.secretModeHint: Nothing you type is kept in this browser, the gallery blurs pictures and hides prompts and tags, and runs are not shown to other tabs or devices. Pictures are still saved to the gallery folder with their settings. Turn it off to save forms again.
app.setupBody: Or connect a backend you already run: a server speaking the diffusers-compatible API (see docs/backend-api.md), or AUTOMATIC1111 / Forge started with --api. Add it on the settings page, or list it in .env.local:
app.setupRestart: Then restart Latentry. Every variable is described in .env.example.
app.setupEngine: Latentry can install and run its own engine on this computer’s GPU. Setup checks the GPU, installs it, and downloads a model.
generate.backendOffline: Backend “{backend}” is not answering. Check that it is running.
generate.backendProblem.auth: It asks for a login (HTTP {status}). Latentry sends only the token set for this backend; it cannot get past a login page in front of the server.
generate.backendProblem.redirect: It answered with a redirect, which Latentry does not follow.
generate.workflowMissing: Not found in this workflow, so left as in the file: {items}.
generate.workflowPromptOnly: A workflow draws from the prompt only: no source image, mask or skeleton pose.
generate.workflowPromptAndPose: This workflow draws from the prompt and can follow a skeleton pose (its latentry:pose node); no source image or mask.
generate.modelNone: No model in the models folder
generate.modelMore: Only downloaded models are listed. Get more on
generate.promptRequiredBody: Enter a positive prompt before generating.
generate.gpuBusyBody: Another client is generating on it right now.
generate.extendNothingBody: Move at least one of the Left, Right, Top or Bottom sliders.
generate.outpaintInvalid: Extend needs at least one side to grow, and the picture can be at most {max} pixels a side.
generate.tooLargeBody: The source picture, mask and pose together are over {limit} MB. Use a smaller or simpler source picture.
generate.artistPlaceholder: Artist name (added to the prompt as “{example}”)
generate.sharedPromptHint: On: every backend's form shows the same prompt and artist, so switching backends keeps them. Off: each backend remembers its own. The negative prompt is always per backend.
generate.positivePlaceholder: Describe the image you want to generate
generate.loraIgnored: This backend does not load LoRAs: a <lora:…> tag is read as plain words. An A1111 web UI and Latentry's engine apply it.
generate.lora.none: No LoRAs yet. Put .safetensors files in the loras folder inside the engine's models folder.
generate.earlier.title: Earlier
generate.queue.title: Waiting
generate.grid.title: X/Y grid
generate.grid.onHint: Draws this run again for each value, so the pictures can be compared side by side.
generate.grid.hintNumbers: Commas between values, or a range: 20-40:5 is 20 to 40 in steps of 5.
generate.grid.hintPrompt: The first value is looked for in the prompt, and each value takes its place in turn. Put a value that has a comma in double quotes.
generate.grid.hintList: Commas between names, as the backend lists them: {names}
generate.grid.heading: {x} × {y}
generate.grid.stopping: Stopping… the backend first finishes the step it is on
generate.grid.sheetSaved: The sheet was saved to the gallery.
generate.grid.error.invalid: The grid could not be read.
generate.grid.error.empty: {axis} axis: enter at least one value.
generate.grid.error.value: {axis} axis: “{value}” is not a value this setting takes.
generate.grid.error.sameAxis: The X and Y axes change the same setting.
generate.grid.error.notInPrompt: {axis} axis: “{value}” is not in the prompt. Prompt S/R looks for its first value there.
generate.grid.error.noHires: Hires denoise needs Hires fix turned on.
generate.grid.error.tooManyCells: A grid can have at most {max} cells.
generate.grid.error.tooManyImages: A grid can draw at most {max} pictures in all (cells × pictures per run).
generate.grid.error.sheetSecret: Sheets are not saved in secret mode.
generate.grid.error.sheetInvalid: The sheet could not be made: its pictures are not all in the save folder, or are not from this grid.
generate.grid.error.sheetNoFolder: No save folder is set, so there is nowhere to put the sheet.
generate.grid.error.sheetBusy: Another sheet is being made. Try again in a moment.
generate.grid.error.sheetFailed: The sheet could not be written to the save folder.
generate.wildcards.none: No wildcards yet. Put .txt files, one choice per line, in the wildcards folder set on Settings.
generate.wildcards.failed: Could not fill in the wildcards
generate.wildcards.unknown: There is no wildcard {name} in the wildcards folder.
generate.wildcards.empty: The wildcard {name} has no lines to choose from.
generate.wildcards.tooDeep: {name} is nested too deep: wildcards may hold wildcards up to 3 levels.
generate.wildcards.tooLong: The prompt grew too long while filling in {name}.
generate.wildcards.noFolder: No wildcards folder is set. Set one on Settings, under Wildcards.
generate.wildcards.notShared: Wildcards are not shared with this device. They can be switched on for paired devices on Settings, on the computer running Latentry.
generate.sizeMultiple: This profile wants sizes in multiples of {multiple}; the backend may round.
generate.customHint: Your own sampler and step count.
generate.hires.title: Hires fix
generate.hires.hint: Upscale each picture and redraw its detail at the larger size. Takes longer.
generate.saveFailed: Generated, but saving to the gallery folder failed ({reason}). Check GALLERY_SAVE_DIR.
generate.sourceDrop: Drop an image or click to choose — leave empty for text-to-image
generate.extendHint: Draws the new area around the picture and a thin strip of its edge, so the seam blends; the rest of the picture stays as it is. Keep it high: the new area has nothing to keep.
generate.upscaleHint: Makes this picture larger and redraws its detail at the new size, from the prompt above. Width and Height below are not used.
generate.strengthHint: Low keeps the source; high redraws more. Output keeps the source's aspect ratio at the width × height area below.
generate.poseHint: Borrows the reference's composition and silhouette and redraws the rest. If the reference's hair, skin or clothes show through, raise it; if the pose drifts, lower it. Exact limb or finger angles aren't kept.
generate.maskHint: Only the painted area is redrawn; everything else stays exactly as the source. Strength around 0.6–0.8 works best; near 1.0 the painted area ignores the source and stops fitting its surroundings.
generate.tagsHint: Reads the source's tags. Character groups (hair, eyes, body, outfit) start selected; click a tag or a group name to toggle.
generate.tagsHintPose: Reads the reference's tags. Only the pose group starts selected, so the reference's hair or outfit doesn't carry over; set the character with a saved character or your own tags.
generate.tagGroup.subject: Subject
generate.characterSaveHint: Saved together with the current artist, negative prompt and seed.
generate.characterSaveSecret: Secret mode: kept in this tab only, and gone when secret mode is turned off.
generate.poseDrop: Drop a picture to follow its pose (the pose is detected and drawn as a skeleton)
generate.poseSkeletonHint: 1.0 is what the pose model was trained at; higher follows more closely but can cost quality. Busy or dynamic poses (running, jumping) are followed least reliably.
generate.poseSizeChanged: The output size changed since this skeleton was drawn; it will be fitted inside. Detect again to line it up.
generate.posePeople: Found {count} people. Pick whose pose to follow.
generate.posePeopleToggle: Found {count} people. Click each one to follow or leave out; at least one stays.
generate.posePeopleOneOrAll: This backend follows one person or everyone. To pick several, its /api/pose takes a list for "person" and answers "person_subsets": true (see docs/backend-api.md).
generate.pose3dHint: Drag to swing the camera around the figure, up to 90° to either side and 45° up or down. Scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag (or Shift-drag, or two fingers) to move the frame: the view shows exactly what the skeleton will cover. Depth is guessed from one picture, so the further it turns, the more often an arm or leg lands in front when it was behind.
generate.pose3dFewJoints: Only {count} of the 17 body joints are in the frame. This model follows the body only, so a close-up gives it little to follow.
generate.pose3dUnavailable: No 3D view here: this backend's /api/pose does not turn a pose. To offer it, /api/pose takes "want_3d" and "camera" and answers with "limits" (see "Turning the pose" in docs/backend-api.md).
generate.pose3dNoZoom: This backend turns the pose but cannot zoom: its /api/pose answers "limits" without "zoom".
generate.poseDropped: This backend cannot follow a pose, so the skeleton you set is left out of the run. Switch back to a backend with pose to use it.
generate.unavailable.title: Not available on this backend: {features}
generate.unavailable.declined: The server says it cannot do this with what it has loaded.
generate.unavailable.kind.a1111.img2img: Latentry cannot send a source image to this kind of backend.
generate.unavailable.kind.a1111.inpaint: Latentry cannot send an inpaint mask to this kind of backend.
generate.unavailable.kind.a1111.pose: Latentry cannot drive pose control on an A1111 web UI. Use a diffusers-compatible server or Latentry's engine for pose.
generate.unavailable.setup.controlnet: Choose a Pose ControlNet for this backend in Settings (an OpenPose ControlNet from ComfyUI's controlnet folder that fits the checkpoint: NoobAI-XL OpenPose for Illustrious and NoobAI models, xinsir's for other SDXL models).
generate.unavailable.setup.engine: Latentry's built-in engine finds the people and draws the skeleton. Start it on the Setup page; it needs no model loaded for this.
generate.unavailable.setup.nodes: This ComfyUI does not list ControlNetLoader and ControlNetApplyAdvanced. Update ComfyUI.
generate.unavailable.setup.marker: This workflow has no LoadImage marked latentry:pose. Add one to its title in ComfyUI, feed it to the workflow's pose nodes, and export it again with Export (API).
generate.unavailable.notReported.img2img: The server's /api/health has "img2img": false or no answer for it. Drop that field (or set it to true) and accept "init_image_base64" and "strength" on /api/generate.
generate.unavailable.notReported.inpaint: The server's /api/health has "inpaint": false or no answer for it. Drop that field (or set it to true) and accept "mask_base64" and "mask_blur" on /api/generate.
generate.unavailable.notReported.pose: The server's /api/health does not say "pose_control": true. To use pose, answer that, add POST /api/pose (draws the skeleton), and accept "pose_image_base64", "pose_is_skeleton" and "pose_strength" on /api/generate. See "POST /api/pose" in docs/backend-api.md.
generate.unavailable.notReported.hires: The server's /api/health does not say "hires": true. If it is Latentry's own engine, it is older than this Latentry: run Repair / update on Setup, then stop and start it. For another server: to use hires fix, answer that, list the upscalers it takes in "upscalers", and accept "hr_scale", "hr_steps", "hr_denoise" and "hr_upscaler" on /api/generate. See docs/backend-api.md.
generate.unavailable.notReported.upscale: The server's /api/health does not say "upscale": true. If it is Latentry's own engine, it is older than this Latentry: run Repair / update on Setup, then stop and start it. For another server: to upscale a source, answer that and accept "upscale": true with "init_image_base64" and the hr_* fields on /api/generate. See docs/backend-api.md.
gallery.notConfigured: Set GALLERY_SAVE_DIR in .env.local to keep every generated image with its settings, and GALLERY_DIRS for other folders to browse (read-only, separated by ;). Then restart Latentry.
gallery.search: Search prompts, tags, models, file names
gallery.sort.label: Order
gallery.sort.indexing: Reading the folder to sort it: {done} / {total} pictures
gallery.sort.tooLarge: This folder has {total} pictures, too many to sort this way. Choose another order.
gallery.filter.namesHint: Names found in this folder's pictures.
gallery.filter.namesReading: Reading the folder for its models: {done} / {total}
gallery.filter.groupHint: Puts pictures that share a prompt, a seed or an X/Y grid into one card. Reads the whole folder first.
gallery.compare.buttonHint: Select two pictures to compare them.
gallery.compare.title: Compare two pictures
gallery.compare.secretHidden: Pictures, settings and tags hidden in secret mode.
gallery.stackHint: {count} pictures. Click to see them all.
gallery.keepSearching: Nothing matched in the files checked so far.
gallery.readOnlyHint: Read-only folder: tags found by WD14 are shown but not written into these files.
gallery.useSettingsHint: Replaces the form's prompts with this picture's and carries over its seed (and, on the same backend, its size, steps, CFG, sampler and hires fix). Tags already in the form are not kept.
gallery.useAsSourceHint: Sets this picture as the form's source image for a variation or edit. Prompts and settings stay as they are.
gallery.useAsPoseHint: Sets this picture as the form's pose reference: its pose carries over, but not its hair or outfit. Prompts and settings stay as they are.
gallery.upscaleHint: Opens this picture in Generate to make it larger and redraw its detail (hires fix for a finished picture). Its prompts come along when it has them.
gallery.revealHint: Opens the folder in this computer's file manager, with the picture selected. Only from this computer.
gallery.openAppHint: Opens the picture in the app this computer uses for pictures. Only from this computer.
gallery.openFailed: Could not open it on this computer.
gallery.analyzeHint: Reads this picture's tags with WD14 and shows them below. In a writable folder they are also saved into the file.
gallery.tagsNotSaved: Tagged, but the file could not be updated.
gallery.noMeta: No settings are stored in this file.
gallery.noMetaTag: No settings are stored in this file. WD14 can still read its tags.
gallery.secretHidden: Picture, prompt, settings and tags hidden in secret mode.
gallery.searchHintTerms: Commas separate terms; every term must match. A term can be several words.
gallery.searchHintExact: Quotes match one tag exactly: not "very long hair". Tags sent from the viewer are quoted.
gallery.searchHintSpelling: Underscores and spaces are the same, and case does not matter.
gallery.searchHintOther: Unquoted terms also match the model and the file name.
gallery.searchHintFields: A setting: model, sampler or lora contains the text; seed, steps, cfg, w and h compare numbers with =, >, >=, < or <=.
gallery.searchHintExclude: A leading - leaves out pictures that match: -smile, -"long hair", -model:pony, -lora:detail.
gallery.cardLessHint: Fold the tags again (or click outside the card, or press Esc)
gallery.skipTagged: Skip pictures that already have tags
gallery.bulkReadOnly: This folder is read-only, so tags cannot be written here. Tagging works in the save folder.
gallery.bulkNoTagger: No backend can tag pictures right now.
lightbox.copyAllHint: Copies every tag in this section to the clipboard, comma-separated.
lightbox.copyHint: Copies this tag to the clipboard.
lightbox.addToSearchHint: Adds this tag to the gallery search.
lightbox.toPositiveHint: Adds this tag to the end of the positive prompt, unless it is already there.
lightbox.toNegativeHint: Adds this tag to the end of the negative prompt, unless it is already there.
lightbox.sendAllPositiveHint: Adds every tag in this section to the end of the positive prompt. Tags the prompt already has are skipped; nothing else in the form changes.
lightbox.sendAllNegativeHint: Adds every tag in this section to the end of the negative prompt. Tags the prompt already has are skipped; nothing else in the form changes.
lightbox.sentAllPositive: Added {what} to the positive prompt, skipping tags already there
lightbox.sentAllNegative: Added {what} to the negative prompt, skipping tags already there
system.viewerError: The image could not be loaded
system.busyStarting: A run is being started on this backend by another request. Try again in a moment.
system.queueFull: {max} runs are already waiting on this backend. Wait for one to start, or cancel one.
system.queueTooLarge: The runs waiting on this backend already hold as many source pictures as Latentry keeps in memory. Wait for one to start, or cancel one.
system.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait {seconds}s and try again.
system.tooManyStreams: Too many live connections from this device. Close some tabs and reload.
system.notPaired: This device is not paired. Open Latentry in the browser to pair it with a code from the computer running it.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Saved to {file} on the server and applied at once, without a restart. Anything you leave untouched keeps coming from .env.local.
settings.lockedRemote: Settings can only be changed on the computer running Latentry (open it at http://localhost). Set SETTINGS_EDIT=lan to allow it from the network.
settings.lockedOff: Settings are read-only here (SETTINGS_EDIT=off). Edit .env.local or latentry.settings.json instead.
settings.backendsHint: The servers that generate images. Each has an id (shown in the UI), a kind, an address and the model profile its form starts from.
settings.backendModelHint: The checkpoint ComfyUI draws with. Test lists the ones it has.
settings.backendControlnetNone: None (no pose on the built-in graph)
settings.backendControlnetHint: The ControlNet the built-in graph follows a skeleton with: an OpenPose ControlNet that fits the checkpoint (NoobAI-XL OpenPose for Illustrious and NoobAI models, xinsir's for other SDXL models). Test lists the ones ComfyUI has. The skeleton is drawn by Latentry's engine, so only the skeleton goes to ComfyUI, never the picture it came from.
settings.backendWorkflowsDirHint: Optional: a folder on this computer with workflows saved from ComfyUI with Export (API). The Generate page offers them next to the built-in graph. Read only.
settings.shareWorkflows: Show workflow names on paired devices
settings.tokenNone: None (Bearer token, if the server needs one)
settings.tokenNoneComfyui: None (ComfyUI has no login; a Bearer token for a proxy in front of it)
settings.openBackendComfyui: This ComfyUI is reached over the network, and ComfyUI has no login: anyone who can reach it can run code on that computer. Run it on this computer, or put it behind a reverse proxy that asks for a login and enter its token here.
settings.openBackendA1111: This web UI is reached over the network without a token: anyone who can reach it can use it. Start it with --api-auth user:password and enter that here, or run it on this computer.
settings.taggerAuto: Automatic: the built-in model if set, else a backend
settings.galleryHint: Folders on this computer. The browser never sees these paths or the folders' own names: each folder is shown by the display name next to it, or by a made-up name such as "Amber Fox".
settings.saveDirHint: Every finished image is saved here with its settings. Created if it does not exist. Leave empty to not save.
settings.readDirsHint: Browse other tools' output here, e.g. ComfyUI's or the web UI's. Latentry never writes to these.
settings.autoTag: Tag every saved image with WD14 as it arrives
settings.loraHashes: Write LoRA hashes into saved images
settings.loraHashesHint: Off by default. On, pictures made with LoRAs on Latentry's engine carry A1111's "Lora hashes", which sites such as Civitai use to link the LoRAs. A hash identifies the exact file on this computer, so anyone you share the picture with can tell which files you have.
settings.wildcardsHint: Write __name__ in a prompt and each run takes one line of name.txt from this folder, picked at random (the same line again for the same fixed seed). Subfolders work as __folder/name__, as in the Dynamic Prompts extension.
settings.wildcardsDirHint: An existing folder of .txt files, one choice per line. Lines starting with # are skipped. Latentry only reads it.
settings.wildcardsShareHint: Off by default. On, paired phones and computers can list the wildcards and use them in their prompts, so they see the names of your files and whatever lines end up in their prompts.
settings.profilesHint: What a form starts from for each model family. Leave a box empty to use the built-in value shown in grey. Changes apply to new forms, a profile switch and a form reset; a form you are already using keeps its values.
settings.tagStyleHint: How tags are written when they reach this profile and when they are sent: long_hair or long hair.
settings.keepTagsHint: Tags kept exactly as written, comma-separated; * matches anything, e.g. score_*. "-" for none.
settings.artistTemplateHint: {artist} stands for the name, e.g. "by {artist}". "-" hides the artist field.
settings.newerFile: The settings file was written by a newer Latentry (settings version {version}). This version leaves it unchanged so nothing in it is lost. Update Latentry to change settings.
settings.errorBackendModel: A checkpoint name of up to 512 characters, on one line.
settings.errorTokenMoved: The address changed: type the token again, or remove it. A saved token is only sent to the server it was saved for.
settings.errorAbsolute: A full path, e.g. D:\pictures\latentry or /home/me/pictures.
settings.errorNetworkPath: Network folders (\\server\share) are off: checking one signs in to that server as you. Set LATENTRY_ALLOW_UNC=1 in .env.local to allow them.
settings.errorFolderLabel: A display name is at most 40 characters.
settings.errorTagStyle: Must be underscores, spaces or as typed.
settings.dir.notDirectory: This is a file, not a folder.
settings.dir.notWritable: Latentry cannot write to this folder.
settings.taggerHint: Tag extraction, gallery tags and bulk tagging. Latentry can run a WD14 model itself (on the CPU, no backend needed), or ask a backend that has a tagger.
settings.wd14DirHint: A folder with model.onnx and selected_tags.csv from a SmilingWolf WD tagger, e.g. wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3 (best) or wd-vit-tagger-v3 (smaller), on Hugging Face.
settings.wd14DirOff: Not set: the built-in tagger is off
settings.wd14Missing: No model.onnx and selected_tags.csv in this folder.
settings.errorBackendReserved: "builtin" is reserved for the built-in tagger.
settings.pairingHint: Devices other than this computer need a code to use Latentry. Add a device here, then type the code on it at the address you open Latentry with. A paired device stays paired for {days} days.
settings.pairingOff: Pairing is off (LATENTRY_PAIRING=off): any device that can reach Latentry can use it.
settings.pairingNetwork: Latentry is open to your network (LATENTRY_HOST): other devices can reach it.
settings.pairingLocal: Latentry listens on this computer only. To use it from other devices, set LATENTRY_HOST=0.0.0.0 and restart it.
settings.pairingCodeHint: Type this code on the other device. It works once, for {minutes}:{seconds} more.
settings.pairingForgetConfirm: Forget every paired device? Each will need a new code.
settings.pairingFailed: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.
settings.pairingRemoveConfirm: Remove “{name}”? It will need a new code to use Latentry again.
setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: Latentry can run its own generation engine on this computer. Everything it installs goes into {dir}; deleting that folder removes it.
setup.notLocal: Setup can only be changed from the computer Latentry runs on.
setup.noGpu: No NVIDIA GPU found. The engine will run on the CPU, which takes minutes per picture.
setup.torchOutdated: PyTorch no longer publishes current releases for this CUDA, so this build is older and has known vulnerabilities. Update the NVIDIA driver to 580 or newer, then run Repair / update, to get a current one.
setup.engineBody: Stock diffusers and PyTorch in a Python environment of their own. The first install downloads about 3–4 GB and takes a few minutes.
setup.steps.packages: Installing PyTorch and the pinned packages, each checked against its hash (the large part)
setup.pinned: Python packages pinned as of {date} and checked against their hashes.
setup.pinnedStale: These pinned packages are from {date}, over six months ago, and may have known vulnerabilities. Check for a Latentry update, or set LATENTRY_ENGINE_PACKAGES=latest and run Repair / update to take the newest.
setup.unpinned.latest: Python packages are the newest ones, not pinned (LATENTRY_ENGINE_PACKAGES=latest). They are not checked against hashes.
setup.unpinned.no-lock: Latentry has no pinned package set for this computer, so the Python packages are not pinned or checked against hashes.
setup.unpinned.missing: A pinned package was no longer offered, so the Python packages were installed unpinned and are not checked against hashes. Run Repair / update after the next Latentry update.
setup.unpinned.new-gpu: The pinned PyTorch does not support this GPU, so the newest PyTorch was installed unpinned and is not checked against hashes.
setup.unpinnedOld: Installed before Latentry pinned its Python packages. Run Repair / update to install the pinned ones.
setup.engineOutdated: This engine runs {running}, but Latentry's folder has engine {folder}: it was started before an update. Stop it and start it again to run {folder}, and run Repair / update if this release asks for it.
setup.shareLoras: Show the LoRA list on paired devices
setup.shareLorasHint: Phones and other paired devices get Add a LoRA on the generate page. The list shows the names of the LoRA files on this computer. Off: only this computer gets it.
setup.modelsBody: Models are not part of Latentry. Each comes from its publisher on Hugging Face, under its own license, into {dir}. Read the license before downloading.
setup.needEngine: Start the engine to download and load models.
setup.emptyFolder: Nothing yet. Download a model below, or put .safetensors files in the folder.
setup.unsupported: Not a model this engine can run
setup.accept: I have read the license and accept it
setup.verifying: Checking the files against their published checksums…
setup.taggerBody: The WD14 tagger reads tags from pictures. It runs inside Latentry, so it needs no engine.
setup.modelsFolderHint: Point it at models you already have, such as a web UI's models/Stable-diffusion folder. Single .safetensors files and diffusers folders directly inside it are listed. The engine restarts to pick it up.
pair.title: Pair this device
pair.hint: On the computer running Latentry, open Settings and choose Add a device, then type the code it shows here.
pair.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Make a new one on the computer running Latentry.
pair.name: Name for this device (optional)
pair.nameHint: Shown in the list of paired devices on the computer running Latentry.
pair.endsOn: The pairing ends on {date} ({days} days left); then it needs a new code.
pair.endsSoon: This device's pairing ends in {days} days.
pair.endsToday: This device's pairing ends within a day.
pair.again: Pair it again with a new code
pair.unpairConfirm: Unpair this device? It will need a new code to use Latentry again.
